name: What is the difference between exterior paint and interior paint?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between exterior paint and interior paint?

acceptedAnswer.text: Exterior paint is formulated to withstand harsh weather conditions, including UV radiation, extreme temperatures, and moisture. It contains binders and additives that provide enhanced durability, flexibility, and resistance to fading, cracking, and mildew growth. Interior paint, on the other hand, is designed for lower wear and tear and focuses more on aesthetics, washability, and low-VOC (volatile organic compound) content for indoor air quality. Using interior paint outdoors will lead to premature failure and poor performance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Exterior paint is built for weather resistance, durability, and UV protection, while interior paint prioritizes aesthetics and indoor air quality. They are not interchangeable.
